title: Tour
description: A short guided walk: a ring on the thing, a card that explains it, and a way out at every step.
usage: Introduce a surface once, in four steps at most: KATATour.start([{el, title, text}, …]). Each step rings its target and anchors the card to it. Skip is always on screen — a tour the reader cannot leave is a modal in disguise.
a11y: Focus moves into the card on each step and the dialog is labelled by its heading. Escape skips the whole tour, arrow-right advances, and nothing the tour points at is ever blocked by it.
